texts.en:
Crossing the border into the [from.solar_system.GetName] system, we encounter no resistance, only a tension deeper than any scan can measure.

This space bears the hallmarks of a civilization long past its zenith, yet far from powerless. Should its attention be drawn to us, we would be found wanting.

Let prudence guide our every move. This is not our domain.

# 古老强权 / An Ancient Power

我国（游牧）舰队进入有通讯、未交战的堕落帝国领土时，对每个堕落帝国收到一次。
Our (nomad) fleet enters the space of a Fallen Empire we are in contact with: once per Fallen Empire.

- 无分支、无后续。No branches or follow-ups.
